carrier_eligibility_provenance.method: Per run, the manifest's logs were searched for the app's own wifi_upgrade ready line (freq_band, freq_source=group) and a completed call; the capability file gives the phone's identity (node prefix, fingerprint). A phone is listed for a carrier only after a call of that carrier held a group with it, so a listing is a measured capability, never an assumption.
